name: Potion of Giant Strength
desc: When you drink this potion, your Strength score changes for 1 hour. The type of giant determines the score (see the table below). The potion has no effect on you if your Strength is equal to or greater than that score.  This potion's transparent liquid has floating in it a sliver of fingernail from a giant of the appropriate type.
